name: Elect
overview: The biblical doctrine of the Elect reveals that God sovereignly chooses those who will be saved, as seen in Ephesians 1:4 where believers are chosen before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless. This divine election is tied to God's foreknowledge and predestination, aiming to conform believers to the image of Christ (Romans 8:29). The elect are assured of God's protection and vindication, as He will avenge those who cry out to Him (Luke 18:7). Furthermore, coming to Christ is a result of the Father's drawing, and all whom the Father gives to the Son will not be rejected (John 6:37, 44), culminating in the ordained receiving eternal life and responding in faith (Acts 13:48).
